body.condition: Under \(P^{\mathrm F}\), the latent variable \(U\) is \(\mathcal U\)-valued and, for every \(x\in\mathcal X\), \(g_x:[0,1]\times\mathcal U\to[0,1]\) is jointly Borel measurable, with one \(P^{\mathrm F}\)-null set outside which \(Y(a)=g_X(a,U)\) for every \(a\in[0,1]\) and \(Y=g_X(A,U)\).
